name: Martin Morning
description: Martin, an ordinary nine-year-old boy, has one strange characteristic: every morning he awakes to find himself transformed into fantastic and legendary beings. Despite the transformations, he goes to school with his friends, and adventures then ensue.

videos.title: Mighty Dragon Martin
videos.overview: Martin is thrilled to wake up and find he's a normal boy for once - but as he gets out of bed, he realises he has a huge dragon tail, little green ears and wings. He can also fly and breathe fire.

videos.title: Martin's Dog Day
videos.overview: Today Martin wakes up next to a big yellow friendly and furry dog - a talking, singing and dancing yellow dog. And although this new friend is quite entertaining, Martin is annoyed by his constant jokes and sends him packing.

videos.title: Martin Multiplied
videos.overview: Martin wakes up to discover two copies of himself sitting beside him. One of them has a red hat and is terribly aggressive while the other wears a blue hat and is terribly sweet.

videos.title: His Majesty Martin
videos.overview: Today Martin is a king and a long chauffer-driven limousine turns up to take him to school. But the evil Colonel Kektumof is waiting for him - he's after Martin's crown and plans to kidnap Martin and his friends.

videos.title: Cro-Magnon Martin
videos.overview: Martin wakes as a prehistoric man. His classmates make fun on him until wild tigers threaten. Then Martin and his primitive instincts turn out to be their salvation.

videos.title: Martin Is Missing
videos.overview: Martin's class is one their way to spend a week in a castle but when he wakes up with green skin, large pointy incisors and no reflection, he decides to hide away and miss the party rather than ask Roxanne to dance with a vampire.

videos.title: Martin's Space Odyssey
videos.overview: This morning Martin looks like a comic book extraterrestrial with his four pairs of bright green tentacles - so much so that real aliens mistake him for their lost Captain Swimsk and beam up on board their spaceship.

videos.title: Charming Martin
videos.overview: Martin would much rather play video games and watch television than read a book - even when he wakes up as a medieval Prince Charming with his own horse and stableman.

videos.title: Agent Martin 008
videos.overview: Waking up as Secret Agent 008 is very exciting until Martin discovers that Vladimir Pestov and his beautiful assistant, Natasha Petrovna Balalaika have sworn to put an end to him.

videos.title: Ancient Egyptian Martin
videos.overview: Today Martin is Prince Martinkamen. When he offers his beautiful gold necklace to Roxanne, he offends the sleeping Gods of Ancient Egypt. Roxanne is carried back in time and Martin must find a way to rescue her.
